news.title: India and India A squads for New Zealand tour announced
matchedLines: Tilak Varma is named in India’s T20I squad as vice-captain.
articleText: The Men’s Selection Committee has announced India and India A squads for the upcoming tour of New Zealand. India will play five T20Is, while India A will play three Multi-Day matches against New Zealand A. The squad for the ODIs and Test series will be announced later.

India’s T20I Squad: Shreyas Iyer (captain), Abhishek Sharma, Sanju Samson (wicketkeeper), Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Ishan Kishan (wicketkeeper), Tilak Varma (vice-captain), Axar Patel, Shivam Dube, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Naman Dhir, Prince Yadav, Mayank Yadav, Arshdeep Singh, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Varun Chakaravarthy and Kuldeep Yadav.

India vs New Zealand T20I schedule: 22 October — 1st T20I, Christchurch; 24 October — 2nd T20I, Christchurch; 27 October — 3rd T20I, Wellington; 30 October — 4th T20I, Auckland; 1 November — 5th T20I, Hamilton.

India A squad: Yashasvi Jaiswal, KL Rahul, Devdutt Padikkal, Ravichandran Smaran, Rishabh Pant (subject to fitness), Dhruv Jurel, Washington Sundar, Auqib Nabi, Akash Deep, Anshul Kamboj, Manav Suthar, Mukesh Choudhary, Sai Sudarsan, Yash Rathod and Mukesh Kumar.
Source: BCCI. This summary highlights the official announcement; refer to the original article for full details.
